sql.query: SELECT t.id tenantId,t.tenantName,CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ut.userId) AS UNSIGNED) peopleCount,CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT team.id) AS UNSIGNED) teamCount FROM tbl_tenants t LEFT JOIN tbl_user_tenants ut ON ut.tenantId=t.id AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' LEFT JOIN tbl_teams team ON team.tenantId=t.id AND team.isActive=1 WHERE t.id=:tenantId GROUP BY t.id,t.tenantName

SELECT team.id,team.teamName,team.description,CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT member.userTenantId) AS UNSIGNED) memberCount,0 sortGroup FROM tbl_teams team LEFT JOIN tbl_team_members member ON member.teamId=team.id AND member.tenantId=team.tenantId AND member.isActive=1 AND member.isPrimary=1 WHERE team.tenantId=:tenantId AND team.isActive=1 GROUP BY team.id,team.teamName,team.description UNION ALL SELECT 0,'Unassigned','People who do not yet have a primary team',CAST(COUNT(*) AS UNSIGNED),1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut WHERE ut.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_team_members member WHERE member.userTenantId=ut.id AND member.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND member.isActive=1 AND member.isPrimary=1) HAVING COUNT(*)>0 ORDER BY sortGroup,teamName

SELECT u.id userId,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.displayName,''),NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ',u.fName,u.lName),''),u.email) displayName,u.email,u.jobTitle,u.avatarPath,UPPER(CONCAT(LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(u.fName,''),u.displayName,u.email),1),LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(u.lName,''),''),1))) initials,ut.positionLevel,ut.reportsToUserId,COALESCE(NULLIF(managerUser.displayName,''),NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ',managerUser.fName,managerUser.lName),''),managerUser.email) reportsToName,CASE WHEN ut.positionLevel IN ('executive','director') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END showInLeadership,CASE WHEN ut.positionLevel IN ('executive','director') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END showInTeam,CASE ut.positionLevel WHEN 'executive' THEN 'Executive / CEO' WHEN 'director' THEN 'Director' WHEN 'manager' THEN 'Manager' ELSE 'Team member' END positionLabel,COALESCE(member.teamId,0) teamId,team.teamName,COALESCE(teamRole.roleDesc,role.roleName,'Team member') roleLabel,teamRole.teamRoleCode,CASE WHEN ut.positionLevel='manager' THEN 0 WHEN teamRole.teamRoleCode='team_manager' THEN 0 WHEN teamRole.teamRoleCode='team_leader' THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(teamRole.teamRoleName,'')) LIKE '%manager%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(teamRole.teamRoleName,'')) LIKE 'head %' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END hierarchyRank,role.roleName accessRole,COALESCE(ut.chatAvailability,'available') availability FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ut.userId AND u.isActive=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_users managerUser ON managerUser.id=ut.reportsToUserId AND managerUser.isActive=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_team_members member ON member.userTenantId=ut.id AND member.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND member.isActive=1 AND member.isPrimary=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_teams team ON team.id=member.teamId AND team.tenantId=member.tenantId AND team.isActive=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_team_roles teamRole ON teamRole.id=member.teamRole AND teamRole.teamId=member.teamId AND teamRole.tenantId=member.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_user_tenant_roles userRole ON userRole.userId=ut.userId AND userRole.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND userRole.isActive=1 AND userRole.isPrimary=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_roles role ON role.id=userRole.roleId AND role.isActive=1 WHERE ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' ORDER BY CASE ut.positionLevel WHEN 'executive' THEN 0 WHEN 'director' THEN 1 WHEN 'manager' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,COALESCE(team.teamName,'ZZZ'),hierarchyRank,displayName
